enrichment.headline: Ratifies moving the Oakland High battery contract from SunPower to TotalEnergies' subsidiary
enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies consent to transfer the district's December 2021 engineering, procurement and construction agreement with SunPower Corporation, for the Oakland High School battery system, to TotalEnergies Distributed Generation USA, LLC. That company is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Renewables USA, LLC. The text states no dollar amount or term change.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $964,222 for Anthonio, Inc. to keep inspecting Cole Administration Center construction through 2024
enrichment.summary: Anthonio, Inc. of Oakland will continue construction inspection for the Cole Administration Center project, including plan review, coordination of special inspectors and closeout paperwork. The amendment adds $964,222 ($877,502 for basic services and $86,720 for contingency), raising the cap from $731,578 to $1,695,800. It also extends the term by 366 days, from December 31, 2023 to December 31, 2024.
